title: Two loaders decide independently what counts as a document
detail: Each loader walks the same directory and applies its own test for what it will accept. Neither is wrong on its own and the pair has no owner, so a file that fails both tests is reported by neither. What the right shape is -- one loader, a shared predicate, or an explicit rejection path -- is not settled by reading the code.

evidence.observation: The loader accepts a file only when it carries a string member naming its schema, and skips anything else without recording that it did.
The second loader applies the same test for its own purposes and skips the same files, so the two agree on what to ignore without either one owning the decision.

verification.check: A file that neither loader accepts is reported by some check, or the run states that it was ignored.
